  BLUS30443_FpsUnlock: &BLUS30443_FpsUnlock
  # Set 60 FPS with no frameskip
  # by Gibbed
    - [ be16, 0x00025ed8, 0x981f ]
  # delta time
  # by Whatcookie
    - [ be32, 0x0001b964, 0x496ac2cd ] # jump to code cave
  # get mftb
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c30, 0x7eac42e6 ] # mftb r21              // move from timebase register (clock)
  # get mftb delta
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c34, 0x3ec00185 ] # lis r22,0x0185        // load high bits of address
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c38, 0x3ad62608 ] # addi r22,r22,0x2608   // load low bits of address
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c3c, 0x7e96a02a ] # ldx r20,r22,r20       // load previous frames mftb reading
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c40, 0xfab60000 ] # std r21,0x0(r22)      // store this frames mftb reading
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c44, 0x7e74a850 ] # subf r19,r21,r20      // subtract previous mftb reading from this mftb frames reading
  # mftb delta to float
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c48, 0xfa760018 ] # std r19,0x18(r22)     // store mftb delta (to be loaded into FPR)
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c4c, 0xcbd60018 ] # lfd f30,0x18(r22)     // load mftb delta into FPR
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c50, 0xffc0f69c ] # fcfid f30,f30         // convert integer to double
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c54, 0xffc0f018 ] # frsp f30,f30          // round to single precision
  # mftb delta to seconds
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c58, 0x3e40016c ] # r18,0x16c             // load high bits constants pointer
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c5c, 0x3a527c30 ] # addi r18,r18,0x7c30   // load low bits of constants pointer
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c60, 0xc3b20054 ] # lfs f29,0x54(r18)     // load timebase frequency constant
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c64, 0xc3920058 ] # lfs f28,0x58(r18)     // load maximum timestep size
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c68, 0xeffee824 ] # fdivs f31,f30,f29     // divide timebase delta by timebase frequency
  # check timestep size
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c6c, 0xff9fe000 ] # fcmpu cr7,f31,f28     // compare current delta time to maximum timestep
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c70, 0x419c0008 ] # blt +0x08             // don't return the maximum timestep size
  # set maximum timestep
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c74, 0xffe0e090 ] # fmr f31,f28           // move maximum timestep to be returned
  # cleanup
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c78, 0x7e94a278 ] # xor r20,r20,r20       // zero r20
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c7c, 0x7e94a278 ] # xor r19,r19,r19       // zero r19
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c80, 0x4e800020 ] # blr                   // return
  # constants
    - [ be32, 0x016c7c84, 0x4c989680 ] # timebase frequency as hexfloat (80mhz)
    - [ bef32, 0x016c7c88, 0.05 ]      # maximum timestep size (50ms or 20 FPS)

  DeS_FPS_Notes: &DeS_FPS_Notes
    "Patch version 2.0 and above is not compatible with the settings used for the previous patch. Clocks scale and Vblank rate must be set to the defaults. Vblank rate can be modified to increase the framelimit beyond 60 FPS. However, it's not recommended as users may encounter physics issues."

  DeS_DDE_Notes: &DeS_DDE_Notes
    "Can disable Write Color Buffers for 20% faster performance. Please note this patch gives a slightly darker tone to the game."

  DeS_AR_Notes: &DeS_AR_Notes
    "Requires \"Stretch To Display Area\" checked in the GPU settings. UI elements will be stretched."

  "Unlock FPS":
    Games:
      "Demon's Souls":
        BLUS30443: [ "01.00" ]
    Author: "Whatcookie, Gibbed"
    Patch Version: 3.0
    Notes: >-
      Brand new patch which fixes most (all?) of the high framerate issues in the game.
      Ontop of the normal gamespeed fixes from the original patch, this patch now also:
      Fixes run speeds at high framerates
      Fixes loss of horizontal speed while falling at high framerates
      Fixes "bouncing" while running up slopes and stairs
      Fixes being unable to move past small steps and wooden planks at high framerates
      Fixes bloodstain playback speed at high framerates
      Fixes health bar and stamina animation speeds at high framerates
      Fixes rounding on stamina drain speed (while running) at uneven framerates
      Head tracking speed should match speed at 30fps at all framerates
      Camera tracking/following speed should match 30fps at all framerates
      Added interpolation between camera keyframes in cutscenes
      (The camera will no longer be stuck at 30hz while animations playback at full speed in cutscenes)
      
    Patch:
      # Core FPS, movement, stairs and camera chase
      # Set 60 FPS with no frameskip
      # by Gibbed
      - [ be16, 0x00025ed8, 0x981f ] # stb r0,0x6ed(r31) // Replace the upper half of the original instruction
      # delta time
      # by Whatcookie
      - [ be32, 0x0001b964, 0x496ac2cd ] # bl 0x16c7c30
      # get mftb
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c30, 0x7eac42e6 ] # mftbl r21 // move from timebase register (clock)
      # get mftb delta
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c34, 0x3ec00185 ] # lis r22,389 // load high bits of address
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c38, 0x3ad62608 ] # addi r22,r22,9736 // load low bits of address
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c3c, 0x7e96a02a ] # ldx r20,r22,r20 // load previous frames mftb reading
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c40, 0xfab60000 ] # std r21,0(r22) // store this frames mftb reading
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c44, 0x7e74a850 ] # subf r19,r20,r21 // subtract previous mftb reading from this mftb frames reading
      # mftb delta to float
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c48, 0xfa61fff8 ] # std r19,-8(r1) // Private tick conversion scratch
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c4c, 0xcbc1fff8 ] # lfd f30,-8(r1) // Load private tick conversion scratch
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c50, 0xffc0f69c ] # fcfid f30,f30 // convert integer to double
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c54, 0xffc0f018 ] # frsp f30,f30 // round to single precision
      # mftb delta to seconds
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c58, 0x3e40016c ] # lis r18,364 // load high bits constants pointer
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c5c, 0x3a527c30 ] # addi r18,r18,31792 // load low bits of constants pointer
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c60, 0xc3b20054 ] # lfs f29,84(r18) // load timebase frequency constant
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c64, 0xc3920058 ] # lfs f28,88(r18) // load maximum timestep size
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c68, 0xeffee824 ] # fdivs f31,f30,f29 // divide timebase delta by timebase frequency
      # check timestep size
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c6c, 0xff9fe000 ] # fcmpu cr7,f31,f28 // compare current delta time to maximum timestep
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c70, 0x419c0008 ] # blt- cr7,0x16c7c78 // don't return the maximum timestep size
      # set maximum timestep
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c74, 0xffe0e090 ] # fmr f31,f28 // move maximum timestep to be returned
      # cleanup
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c78, 0x7e94a278 ] # xor r20,r20,r20 // zero r20
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c7c, 0xd3f60018 ] # stfs f31,24(r22) // Publish completed frame dt in the existing FPS scratch slot
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c80, 0x4e800020 ] # blr // return
      # constants
      - [ be32, 0x016c7c84, 0x4c989680 ] # float 80000000 // Timebase frequency in Hz
      - [ bef32, 0x016c7c88, 0.05 ]      # float 0.05 // Maximum timestep of 50 ms

      # Fix high framerate running slowdown
      - [ be32, 0x002ec490, 0x4bfffef8 ] # b 0x002ec388 // Use the existing recovery path instead of the low-progress penalty

      # Airborne, slope impulse and non-steep damping are inline in the movement owner below
      # Vector lane construction replaces redundant private stack reconstruction
      # Non-steep damping retains the existing polynomial and its exact scalar constants

      # Fix high framerate stair bouncing in place
      # Keep the selected foot correction in f0 instead of selecting a stack pointer in r9
      # f12 is volatile and unused elsewhere in this function; f30 is the actor update interval
      - [ bd32, 0x002f5da0, 0xc19e8840 ] # lfs f12,-30656(r30) // Original addi r9,r1,116; load 30.0 on selection path A
      - [ bd32, 0x002f5e04, 0xc19e8840 ] # lfs f12,-30656(r30) // Original addi r9,r1,116; load 30.0 on selection path B
      - [ bd32, 0x002f5e28, 0xc19e8840 ] # lfs f12,-30656(r30) // Original addi r9,r1,116; load 30.0 on selection path C
      - [ bd32, 0x002f5df0, 0xfc006890 ] # fmr f0,f13 // Original addi r9,r1,112; select the other foot value directly
      - [ bd32, 0x002f5db0, 0xed9e0332 ] # fmuls f12,f30,f12 // Original clrldi r9,r9,32; compute dt * 30
      # The original lfs f13,-32612(r30) at 0x002f5db8 still loads the 0.2 gain
      - [ bd32, 0x002f5dbc, 0xedad0332 ] # fmuls f13,f13,f12 // Original lfs f0,0(r9); scale the gain before the unchanged fmadds

      # Camera chase timing shared routine
      # 0x0011873c is an unreferenced alignment NOP after a return instruction
      # Call sites select an FPR in r0, or 14 for the three-axis vector coefficient
      - [ calloc, 0x0011873e, 314 ] # Hook 0x0011873c // Original nop

  "Unlock FPS":
    Games:
      "Demon's Souls":
        BLES00932: [ "01.00" ]
    Author: "Whatcookie, Gibbed"
    Patch Version: 3.0
    Notes: >-
      Brand new patch which fixes most (all?) of the high framerate issues in the game.
      Ontop of the normal gamespeed fixes from the original patch, this patch now also:
      Fixes run speeds at high framerates
      Fixes loss of horizontal speed while falling at high framerates
      Fixes "bouncing" while running up slopes and stairs
      Fixes being unable to move past small steps and wooden planks at high framerates
      Fixes bloodstain playback speed at high framerates
      Fixes health bar and stamina animation speeds at high framerates
      Fixes rounding on stamina drain speed (while running) at uneven framerates
      Head tracking speed should match speed at 30fps at all framerates
      Camera tracking/following speed should match 30fps at all framerates
      Added interpolation between camera keyframes in cutscenes
      (The camera will no longer be stuck at 30hz while animations playback at full speed in cutscenes)
      
    Patch:
      # Core FPS, movement, stairs and camera chase
      # Set 60 FPS with no frameskip
      # by Gibbed
      - [ be16, 0x00026ac0, 0x981f ] # stb r0,0x6ed(r31) // Replace the upper half of the original instruction
      # delta time
      # by Whatcookie
      - [ be32, 0x0001c534, 0x496ada4d ] # bl 0x16c7c30
      # get mftb
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f80, 0x7eac42e6 ] # mftbl r21 // move from timebase register (clock)
      # get mftb delta
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f84, 0x3ec00185 ] # lis r22,389 // load high bits of address
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f88, 0x3ad62608 ] # addi r22,r22,9736 // load low bits of address
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f8c, 0x7e96a02a ] # ldx r20,r22,r20 // load previous frames mftb reading
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f90, 0xfab60000 ] # std r21,0(r22) // store this frames mftb reading
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f94, 0x7e74a850 ] # subf r19,r20,r21 // subtract previous mftb reading from this mftb frames reading
      # mftb delta to float
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f98, 0xfa61fff8 ] # std r19,-8(r1) // Private tick conversion scratch
      - [ be32, 0x016c9f9c, 0xcbc1fff8 ] # lfd f30,-8(r1) // Load private tick conversion scratch
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fa0, 0xffc0f69c ] # fcfid f30,f30 // convert integer to double
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fa4, 0xffc0f018 ] # frsp f30,f30 // round to single precision
      # mftb delta to seconds
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fa8, 0x3e40016d ] # lis r18,364 // load high bits constants pointer
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fac, 0x3a529f80 ] # addi r18,r18,31792 // load low bits of constants pointer
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fb0, 0xc3b20054 ] # lfs f29,84(r18) // load timebase frequency constant
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fb4, 0xc3920058 ] # lfs f28,88(r18) // load maximum timestep size
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fb8, 0xeffee824 ] # fdivs f31,f30,f29 // divide timebase delta by timebase frequency
      # check timestep size
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fbc, 0xff9fe000 ] # fcmpu cr7,f31,f28 // compare current delta time to maximum timestep
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fc0, 0x419c0008 ] # blt- cr7,0x16c7c78 // don't return the maximum timestep size
      # set maximum timestep
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fc4, 0xffe0e090 ] # fmr f31,f28 // move maximum timestep to be returned
      # cleanup
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fc8, 0x7e94a278 ] # xor r20,r20,r20 // zero r20
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fcc, 0xd3f60018 ] # stfs f31,24(r22) // Publish completed frame dt in the existing FPS scratch slot
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fd0, 0x4e800020 ] # blr // return
      # constants
      - [ be32, 0x016c9fd4, 0x4c989680 ] # float 80000000 // Timebase frequency in Hz
      - [ bef32, 0x016c9fd8, 0.05 ]      # float 0.05 // Maximum timestep of 50 ms

      # Fix high framerate running slowdown
      - [ be32, 0x002ed268, 0x4bfffef8 ] # b 0x002ec388 // Use the existing recovery path instead of the low-progress penalty

      # Airborne, slope impulse and non-steep damping are inline in the movement owner below
      # Vector lane construction replaces redundant private stack reconstruction
      # Non-steep damping retains the existing polynomial and its exact scalar constants

      # Fix high framerate stair bouncing in place
      # Keep the selected foot correction in f0 instead of selecting a stack pointer in r9
      # f12 is volatile and unused elsewhere in this function; f30 is the actor update interval
      - [ bd32, 0x002f6b78, 0xc19e8840 ] # lfs f12,-30656(r30) // Original addi r9,r1,116; load 30.0 on selection path A
      - [ bd32, 0x002f6bdc, 0xc19e8840 ] # lfs f12,-30656(r30) // Original addi r9,r1,116; load 30.0 on selection path B
      - [ bd32, 0x002f6c00, 0xc19e8840 ] # lfs f12,-30656(r30) // Original addi r9,r1,116; load 30.0 on selection path C
      - [ bd32, 0x002f6bc8, 0xfc006890 ] # fmr f0,f13 // Original addi r9,r1,112; select the other foot value directly
      - [ bd32, 0x002f6b88, 0xed9e0332 ] # fmuls f12,f30,f12 // Original clrldi r9,r9,32; compute dt * 30
      # The original lfs f13,-32612(r30) at 0x002f5db8 still loads the 0.2 gain
      - [ bd32, 0x002f6b94, 0xedad0332 ] # fmuls f13,f13,f12 // Original lfs f0,0(r9); scale the gain before the unchanged fmadds

      # Camera chase timing shared routine
      # 0x0011873c is an unreferenced alignment NOP after a return instruction

      - [ calloc, 0x00119706, 314 ] # Hook 0x0011873c // Original nop

Anchors:
  gow_hd_4_3_notes: &gow_hd_4_3_notes
    "Requires \"Stretch To Display Area\" checked in the GPU settings. Restores original viewport size from PS2 releases. The remastered versions of the first two games handled a 16:9 aspect ratio by cropping out 25% of the vertical viewport instead of expanding the horizontal FOV."
  gow_hd_16_9_notes: &gow_hd_16_9_notes
    "Like the PS2 releases, the remastered versions of the first two games handle 16:9 aspect ratio by cropping out 25% of the vertical viewport instead of expanding the horizontal FOV. This patch fixes it and makes the game render in proper 16:9."

        NPEA00256: [ 01.01 ]
    Author: "Dobrido"
    Notes: "Restores exact PS3 behavior: forces the PS3 NTSC frametime (1/59.94) and caps logic at 59.94 steps/s, fixing RPCS3 overspeed while keeping frame-precise physics intact."
    Patch Version: 2.0
    Patch:
      - [ be32, 0x002b8cd0, 0x48254f78 ] # b 0x0050dc48            hook the fdivs -> big cave (alloc-scratch build)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc48, 0x3d800f00 ] # lis r12,0x0f00          scratch base = patch-ALLOCATED RW page 0x0f000000 (game can't stomp it)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc4c, 0x3d400067 ] # lis r10,0x67
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc50, 0xa00a0bf2 ] # lhz r0,0x0bf2(r10)      r0 = C16 of frame counter [0x670bf0]
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc54, 0xa14c0004 ] # lhz r10,4(r12)          r10 = last_C16 [0x0f000004]
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc58, 0xa16c0006 ] # lhz r11,6(r12)          r11 = cached dec [0x0f000006]
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc5c, 0x7f805000 ] # cmpw cr7,r0,r10
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc60, 0x419e004c ] # beq cr7,0x0050dcac      same frame -> APPLY (cached dec)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc64, 0x7c6c42e6 ] # mftb r3                 (new frame)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc68, 0x7863ba42 ] # srdi r3,r3,9            r3 = now/512
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc6c, 0x816c0000 ] # lwz r11,0(r12)          r11 = next_step_now [0x0f000000]
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc70, 0x7d4b1850 ] # subf r10,r11,r3         elapsed = now - next_step_now
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc74, 0x2f8a0a32 ] # cmpwi cr7,r10,0xa32     lag threshold ~59.89fps: any slower frame -> native delta (kills slow-motion; raise toward 0xa80 if speed creeps at stable fps)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc78, 0x419d001c ] # bgt cr7,0x0050dc94      -> lag: resync + NATIVE dt (PS3-like delta compensation)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc7c, 0x2f8a0000 ] # cmpwi cr7,r10,0         step due?
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc80, 0x419c0020 ] # blt cr7,0x0050dca0      no -> skip
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc84, 0x394b0a30 ] # addi r10,r11,0xa30      cap = 59.94 steps/s (calibrated - do not change; bigger=slower)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc88, 0x914c0000 ] # stw r10,0(r12)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc8c, 0x39600001 ] # li r11,1                dec = 1 (feed PS3 dt)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc90, 0x48000014 ] # b 0x0050dca4            -> pack
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc94, 0x906c0000 ] # stw r3,0(r12)           lag: resync
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc98, 0x39600003 ] # li r11,3                dec = 3 (feed NATIVE dt this frame)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dc9c, 0x48000008 ] # b 0x0050dca4            -> pack
      - [ be32, 0x0050dca0, 0x39600000 ] # li r11,0                skip: dec = 0 (feed tiny)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dca4, 0x500b801e ] # rlwimi r11,r0,16,0,15   word2 = C16<<16 | dec
      - [ be32, 0x0050dca8, 0x916c0004 ] # stw r11,4(r12)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcac, 0x716b0003 ] # andi. r11,r11,3         (APPLY) dec = word2 & 3
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcb0, 0x2f8b0003 ] # cmpwi cr7,r11,3         lag frame?
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcb4, 0xec1f0024 ] # fdivs f0,f31,f0         f0 = NATIVE dt (original instruction)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcb8, 0x419e0020 ] # beq cr7,0x0050dcd8      lag -> keep native dt
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcbc, 0x3c003c88 ] # lis r0,0x3c88           build PS3 dt in REGS
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcc0, 0x6000ab85 ] # ori r0,r0,0xab85        0x3C88AB85 = 1/59.94
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcc4, 0x9001fff8 ] # stw r0,-8(r1)           stack red zone
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcc8, 0xc001fff8 ] # lfs f0,-8(r1)           f0 = PS3 dt
      - [ be32, 0x0050dccc, 0x4082000c ] # bne cr0,0x0050dcd8      step -> PS3 dt
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcd0, 0xec000032 ] # fmuls f0,f0,f0          skip: const^2
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcd4, 0xec000032 ] # fmuls f0,f0,f0          skip: const^4 (tiny, not 0)
      - [ be32, 0x0050dcd8, 0x4bdaaffc ] # b 0x002b8cd4            native code writes frametime from f0
      - [ alloc, 0x0f000003, 0x1000 ] # 4KB RW scratch page at 0x0f000000 (zeroized, VM-reserved; game can't stomp it)

    - [ be32, 0x00f7c3b8, 0x386001f5 ] # li r3, 1f5
    - [ be32, 0x00711b50, 0x489c3ef1 ] # jump to code cave
  # get mftb
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a40, 0x7ccc42e6 ] # mftb r6             // move from timebase register (clock)
  # get mftb delta
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a44, 0x3ca0010e ] # lis r5,0x010e       // load high bits of address (0x010e23c8)
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a48, 0x60a523c8 ] # ori r5,r5,0x23c8    // load low bits of address
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a4c, 0x7c85202a ] # ldx r4,r5,r4        // load previous frames mftb reading
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a50, 0xf8c50000 ] # std r6,0x0(r5)      // store this frames mftb reading
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a54, 0x7cc43050 ] # subf r6,r4,r6       // subtract previous mftb reading from this mftb frames reading
  # mftb delta to float
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a58, 0xf8c50080 ] # std r6,0x80(r5)     // store mftb delta (to be loaded into FPR)
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a5c, 0xcba50080 ] # lfd f29,0x80(r5)    // load mftb delta into FPR
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a60, 0xffa0ee9c ] # fcfid f29,f29       // convert integer to double
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a64, 0xffa0e818 ] # frsp f29,f29        // round to single precision
  # mftb delta to seconds
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a68, 0x3c80010d ] # r4,0x10d            // load high bits constants pointer
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a6c, 0x60845a40 ] # ori r4,r4,0x5a40    // load low bits of constants pointer
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a70, 0xc384003c ] # lfs f28,0x3c(r4)    // load timebase frequency
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a74, 0xec3de024 ] # fdivs f1,f29,f28    // divide timebase delta by timebase frequency
  # return
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a78, 0x4e800020 ] # blr                 // return
  # constants
    - [ be32, 0x010d5a7c, 0x4c989680 ] # timebase frequency as hexfloat (80mhz)

  tlou_gpulighting_notes: &tlou_gpulighting_notes
    "Uses GPU (RSX) path for lighting effects instead of SPU.\nFixes rendering of lightning effects that are being rendered broken via SPU path and greatly improves performance over it.\nThis path is incomplete and results in some missing effects such as Volumetric lighting.\nVersion 2.0 - Fixes Cabin Resort level crashes/artifacts without removing the fog (1.11 only)"

  tlou_debugmenu_notes: &tlou_debugmenu_notes
    "L3 + Start = Dev Menu\nL3 + Select = Quick Menu\nL3 + Triangle = FPS Text\nL3 + R3 = Debug Fly"

  tlou_infiniteflashlight_notes: &tlou_infiniteflashlight_notes
    "This patch is useful for people who play with something other than DualShock3/4.\nNormaly flashlight battery drains after ~3600 frames, patch disables battery drain, Infinite flashlight battery no controller shake."

  tlou_nocamshake_notes: &tlou_nocamshake_notes
    "Disables camera shake during gameplay.\nIn-Game cinematics remain unaffected."

  tlou_localmp_notes: &tlou_localmp_notes
    "Matchmaking does not work."

  tlou_dbgtasks_notes: &tlou_dbgtasks_notes
    "Only enable this if you know what you are doing!"

  tlou_headcrash_notes: &tlou_headcrash_notes
    "Fixes a bug where throwing an object at an Infected Severed Head causes a game crash."

  tlou_ar_notes: &tlou_ar_notes
    "Requires \"Stretch To Display Area\" checked in the GPU settings. UI elements will be stretched."

  tlou_fps_notes: &tlou_fps_notes
    "Framelimit OFF is required to go above 60 FPS, beware this can cause buggy character movement and will speed up cutscenes.\nThe game may crash above 500 FPS in loading screens."

  tlou_mlaa_notes: &tlou_mlaa_notes
    "Allows for the use of Resolution Scaling and improves performance.\nVersion 2.0 - Fixes crashes introduced in the original patch.\nVersion 3.0 - Fixes the Green Rain in more areas.\nVersion 4.0 - Fixes high levels of Bloom in some areas.\n\nKnown issues: Listen mode does not work."

  tlou_mesh_notes: &tlou_mesh_notes
    "Allows the game to render correctly at higher resolutions than what the PS3 supports."

  uc3_fps_notes: &uc3_fps_notes
    "Set Framelimit to \"Off\" to go above 60 FPS.\nCutscenes will speed up over 60 FPS. Water wave physics/animations and rain animations will speed up over 30 FPS. Spiders will be more difficult or impossible to escape from, you may need to cap your framerate.\n"

  uc3_debugmenu_notes: &uc3_debugmenu_notes
    "L3 + Start = Dev Menu\nL3 + Select = Quick Menu\nL3 + Triangle = Debug Text\nL2 + R2 = Debug Fly"

  uc3_mlaa_notes: &uc3_mlaa_notes
    "Allows for the use of Resolution Scaling in the title and improves performance.\nVersion 2.0 Fixes high levels of bloom in some areas. (1.10 and 1.19 Only)\nVersion 3.0 Fixes Crash in some multiplayer levels. (1.19 Only)"

  uc3_gpulighting_notes: &uc3_gpulighting_notes
    "Uses GPU (RSX) path for lighting effects instead of SPU.\nFixes rendering of lighting effects that are broken via SPU path and greatly improves performance over it.\nThis path is incomplete and results in some missing effects such as Volumetric lighting."

  uc3_camshake_notes: &uc3_camshake_notes
    "Disables Camera Shake during gameplay.\nIn-Game-Cinematics are unaffected."

  uc3_coop_sp_notes: &uc3_coop_sp_notes
    "Issues are expected!\nEnable Debug Menu patch and while in-game, open Quick Menu, and select Player 2.\nKnown Issues:\nPlayer 2 doesn't have a playermodel.\nPlayer 2 cannot move in some levels."

  uc3_mesh_notes: &uc3_mesh_notes
    "Allows the game to render correctly at higher resolutions than what the PS3 supports."

  "Enable Motion Blur in Gameplay - 24 Samples":
    Games:
      "Gran Turismo 5":
        BCUS98114: [02.11]
    Author: "TheAdmiester"
    Patch Version: 1.0
    Group: "Motion Blur"
    Notes: "Enables replay motion blur in gameplay modes with a couple of fixes to stop it breaking mirrors. Also upgrades motion blur to 24 samples vs 8."

    Configurable Values:
      "Shutter Rate":
        Type: double_range
        Value: 0.6
        Min: 0.0
        Max: 2.0

    Patch:
      # Force replay motion blur in gameplay scene mode
      - [be32, 0x0045B534, 0x38A00001]

      # User-definable shutter rate aka motion blur length
      - [bef32, 0x01456DD4, "Shutter Rate"]

      # Skip applying to mirrors' cameras
      - [be32, 0x008A9418, 0x81240000] # lwz  r9, 0(r4) (was mr r3, r4)
      - [be32, 0x008A943C, 0x83290000] # lwz  r25, 0(r9) (was bl sub_2568B0)
      - [be32, 0x008A9440, 0x83490008] # lwz  r26, 8(r9)  (was mr r25, r3)
      - [be32, 0x008A9444, 0x80090084] # lwz  r0, 0x84(r9) (was mr r3, r27)
      - [be32, 0x008A9448, 0x2F9A0000] # cmpwi cr7, r26, 0 (was bl sub_3E3BBC)
      - [be32, 0x008A944C, 0x2B000002] # cmplwi cr6, r0, 2 (was cmpwi cr7, r3, 0)
      - [be32, 0x008A9450, 0x4FDECB82] # cror cr7.eq, cr7.eq, cr6.gt (was mr r26, r3)
      - [be32, 0x008A95F0, 0x81240000] # lwz  r9, 0(r4) (was mr r3, r4)
      - [be32, 0x008A9610, 0x83E90008] # lwz  r31, 8(r9) (was bl sub_3E3BBC)
      - [be32, 0x008A9614, 0x80090084] # lwz  r0, 0x84(r9)(was mr r31, r3)
      - [be32, 0x008A9618, 0x2B000002] # cmplwi cr6, r0, 2 (was mr r3, r29)
      - [be32, 0x008A9624, 0x4199003C] # bgt  cr6, loc_8A9660 (was bl sub_2568B0)
      - [be32, 0x008A9630, 0x83490000] # lwz  r26, 0(r9) (was mr r26, r3)

  "Enable Motion Blur in Gameplay - 16 Samples":
    Games:
      "Gran Turismo 5":
        BCES00569: [02.11]
    Author: "TheAdmiester"
    Patch Version: 1.0
    Group: "Motion Blur"
    Notes: "Enables replay motion blur in gameplay modes with a couple of fixes to stop it breaking mirrors. Also upgrades motion blur to 16 samples vs 8."

    Configurable Values:
      "Shutter Rate":
        Type: double_range
        Value: 0.6
        Min: 0.0
        Max: 2.0

    Patch:
      # Force replay motion blur in gameplay scene mode
      - [be32, 0x0045B534, 0x38A00001]

      # User-definable shutter rate aka motion blur length
      - [bef32, 0x01456DD4, "Shutter Rate"]

      # Skip applying to mirrors' cameras
      - [be32, 0x008A9418, 0x81240000] # lwz  r9, 0(r4) (was mr r3, r4)
      - [be32, 0x008A943C, 0x83290000] # lwz  r25, 0(r9) (was bl sub_2568B0)

      - [be32, 0x008A9444, 0x80090084] # lwz  r0, 0x84(r9) (was mr r3, r27)
      - [be32, 0x008A9448, 0x2F9A0000] # cmpwi cr7, r26, 0 (was bl sub_3E3BBC)
      - [be32, 0x008A944C, 0x2B000002] # cmplwi cr6, r0, 2 (was cmpwi cr7, r3, 0)
      - [be32, 0x008A9450, 0x4FDECB82] # cror cr7.eq, cr7.eq, cr6.gt (was mr r26, r3)
      - [be32, 0x008A95F0, 0x81240000] # lwz  r9, 0(r4) (was mr r3, r4)
      - [be32, 0x008A9610, 0x83E90008] # lwz  r31, 8(r9) (was bl sub_3E3BBC)
      - [be32, 0x008A9614, 0x80090084] # lwz  r0, 0x84(r9)(was mr r31, r3)
      - [be32, 0x008A9618, 0x2B000002] # cmplwi cr6, r0, 2 (was mr r3, r29)

      - [be32, 0x008A9630, 0x83490000] # lwz  r26, 0(r9) (was mr r26, r3)

      - [be32, 0x0045B534, 0x38A00001]

  DS1_BLES01765_FPS: &DS1_BLES01765_FPS
  # delta time hook
    - [ be32, 0x00145458, 0x494a70c9 ] # bl 0x015ec520           // replace fixed 1/30 timestep load with dynamic delta-time routine

  # native PTDE 60 FPS / no-skip mode hook
    - [ be32, 0x0014943c, 0x494a3129 ] # bl 0x015ec564           // jump to FlipMode setup routine

  # writable scratch area
    - [ be32, 0x019f2330, 0x00000000 ] # previous mftb [high]    // saved previous timebase reading
    - [ be32, 0x019f2334, 0x00000000 ] # previous mftb [low]     // saved previous timebase reading
    - [ be32, 0x019f2338, 0x00000000 ] # mftb delta [high]       // temporary integer delta for FPR conversion
    - [ be32, 0x019f233c, 0x00000000 ] # mftb delta [low]        // temporary integer delta for FPR conversion
    - [ be32, 0x019f2340, 0x4c989680 ] # 80,000,000.0f           // PS3 PPU timebase frequency constant
    - [ bef32, 0x019f2344, 0.05 ]      # 0.05f                   // maximum timestep size (50 ms)

  # get mftb
    - [ be32, 0x015ec520, 0x7d4c42e6 ] # mftb r10                // move from timebase register (clock)

  # get mftb delta
    - [ be32, 0x015ec524, 0x3d20019f ] # lis r9,0x019f           // load high bits of scratch address (0x019f2330)
    - [ be32, 0x015ec528, 0x61292330 ] # ori r9,r9,0x2330        // load low bits of scratch address
    - [ be32, 0x015ec52c, 0xe9690000 ] # ld r11,0(r9)            // load previous frame's mftb reading
    - [ be32, 0x015ec530, 0xf9490000 ] # std r10,0(r9)           // store this frame's mftb reading
    - [ be32, 0x015ec534, 0x7d8b5050 ] # subf r12,r11,r10        // subtract previous mftb reading from current mftb

  # mftb delta to float
    - [ be32, 0x015ec538, 0xf9890008 ] # std r12,0x8(r9)         // store mftb delta so it can be loaded into an FPR
    - [ be32, 0x015ec53c, 0xc8090008 ] # lfd f0,0x8(r9)          // load integer mftb delta into FPR
    - [ be32, 0x015ec540, 0xfc00069c ] # fcfid f0,f0             // convert integer to double
    - [ be32, 0x015ec544, 0xfc000018 ] # frsp f0,f0              // round to single precision

  # mftb delta to seconds
    - [ be32, 0x015ec548, 0xc0490010 ] # lfs f2,0x10(r9)         // load timebase frequency constant (80,000,000.0f)
    - [ be32, 0x015ec54c, 0xc0690014 ] # lfs f3,0x14(r9)         // load maximum timestep size (0.05f)
    - [ be32, 0x015ec550, 0xffe01024 ] # fdiv f31,f0,f2          // divide timebase delta by timebase frequency

  # check timestep size
    - [ be32, 0x015ec554, 0xff9f1800 ] # fcmpu cr7,f31,f3        // compare current delta time to maximum timestep
    - [ be32, 0x015ec558, 0x419c0008 ] # blt cr7,+0x8            // keep current delta if it is below the maximum
    - [ be32, 0x015ec55c, 0xffe01890 ] # fmr f31,f3              // otherwise clamp delta time to 0.05f
    - [ be32, 0x015ec560, 0x4e800020 ] # blr                     // return to 0x0014545c

    - [ be32, 0x015ec564, 0x38800003 ] # li r4,0x3               // select PTDE FlipMode 3 = 60FPS(NO SKIP)

    - [ be32, 0x015ec578, 0x4e800020 ] # blr                     // return to 0x00149440

        "600 FPS": 0.0010416667
  fix_rewind_tolerance: &fix_rewind_tolerance
    # Load current time step to f11
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x3d200002 ] # lis    r9,2
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x61290030 ] # ori    r9,r9,48
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0xc9690000 ] # lfd    f11,0(r9)
    # Load 1/60 to f0
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x39200000 ] # li     r9, 0
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x3d203f91 ] # lis    r9,16273
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x61291111 ] # ori    r9,r9,4369
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x91210030 ] # stw    r9,0x30(r1)
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x3d201111 ] # lis    r9,4369
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x61291111 ] # ori    r9,r9,4369
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x91210034 ] # stw    r9,0x34(r1)
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0xc8010030 ] # lfd    f0,0x30(r1)
    # Divide 1/60 with current timestep
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0xfc005824 ] # fdiv   f0,f0,f11
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0xfc000018 ] # frsp   f0,f0
    # Multiply rewind tolerance frequency adjustment factor with the result
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0xec210032 ] # fmuls  f1,f1,f0
    - [ be32, 0x0, 0x3c8000a4 ] # lis    r4,0xa4

Anchors:
  SHD_unlockfps_notes: &SHD_unlockfps_notes
    "Removes 62 FPS limit.\nMaximum framerate with the patch is half the Vblank frequency."

  SHD_DOF_notes: &SHD_DOF_notes
    "Disables the DoF effect which doesn't correctly scale with resolution upscaling. This patch may slightly affect color-grading and will reduce bloom intensity because those effects share the same shader pipeline with DoF. Additionally, 16x Anisotropic Filtering can now be forced via custom config without causing issues."

  SHD_MLAA_notes: &SHD_MLAA_notes
    "Removes both Morphological Anti-Aliasing (MLAA) and Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing (FXAA), post-process AA solutions that significantly impact image definition and sharpness. Particularly useful when using resolution upscaling."

  SHD_titles: &SHD_titles
    "Silent Hill Downpour":
      BLES01446: [ 01.01 ]
      BLUS30565: [ 01.01 ]

    Games:

        BCUS98282: [ 01.00 ]
    Author: "Alexis"
    Patch Version: 1.2
    Patch:
      - [ be32, 0x00147cf0, 0x38c60001 ] # restart from loop section (v1.1 fallback)
      - [ be32, 0x00147d8c, 0x41820008 ] # state 8 -> queue loop section as before
      - [ be32, 0x00147d90, 0x4853ad10 ] # otherwise check whether another loop copy is needed
      - [ be32, 0x00147da4, 0x60000000 ] # nop (old state 9 check, cr0 is now from the state 8 test)
      # Code cave in unused snd_PrintStreamTree (0x682aa0)
      - [ be32, 0x00682aa0, 0x2c030004 ] # cmpwi cr0,r3,4  ; state 4 = loop section queued/playing
      - [ be32, 0x00682aa4, 0x40820044 ] # bne cr0,0x682ae8
      - [ be32, 0x00682aa8, 0xa0bb0048 ] # lhz r5,72(r27)  ; loop flag
      - [ be32, 0x00682aac, 0x70a50001 ] # andi. r5,r5,0x1
      - [ be32, 0x00682ab0, 0x41820038 ] # beq cr0,0x682ae8
      - [ be32, 0x00682ab4, 0x7fc3f378 ] # mr r3,r30  ; handle
      - [ be32, 0x00682ab8, 0x38810070 ] # addi r4,r1,112  ; &count (stack scratch)
      - [ be32, 0x00682abc, 0x48000471 ] # bl 0x682f2c  ; snd stream queue length (pending entries)
      - [ be32, 0x00682ac0, 0x2c030000 ] # cmpwi cr0,r3,0
      - [ be32, 0x00682ac4, 0x41820024 ] # beq cr0,0x682ae8  ; bad handle
      - [ be32, 0x00682ac8, 0x80610070 ] # lwz r3,112(r1)
      - [ be32, 0x00682acc, 0x2c030000 ] # cmpwi cr0,r3,0
      - [ be32, 0x00682ad0, 0x40820018 ] # bne cr0,0x682ae8  ; still something queued
      - [ be32, 0x00682ad4, 0x83db0040 ] # lwz r30,64(r27)
      - [ be32, 0x00682ad8, 0xa87b0044 ] # lha r3,68(r27)  ; index
      - [ be32, 0x00682adc, 0xa09b0046 ] # lhz r4,70(r27)  ; volume
      - [ be32, 0x00682ae0, 0xa0bb0048 ] # lhz r5,72(r27)  ; flags
      - [ be32, 0x00682ae4, 0x4bac52d0 ] # b 0x147db4  ; queue music[n+1] again (state 8 path)
      - [ be32, 0x00682ae8, 0x4bac537c ] # b 0x147e64  ; back

  "Unlock FPS":
    Games:
      "Dante's Inferno":
        BLUS30405: [ 01.04 ]
        BLES00713: [ 01.04 ]
    Author: "franks"
    Patch Version: 1.0
    Patch:
  # dt hook
      - [ be32, 0x00B0A99C, 0x4BF4CC8D ] # jump to dt cave - stfs f11,-0x7e28(r9) -> bl 0x00A57628

  # dt cave - handles game's speed
    # read the clock
      - [ be32, 0x00A57628, 0x3CA00145 ] # lis r5,0x0145           
      - [ be32, 0x00A5762C, 0x38A597A8 ] # addi r5,r5,0x97A8       // r5 = our scratch data
      - [ be32, 0x00A57630, 0x7C6C42A6 ] # mftb r3                 // read the CPU clock
      - [ be32, 0x00A57634, 0xE8C50000 ] # ld r6,0(r5)             // the clock reading from last frame
      - [ be32, 0x00A57638, 0xF8650000 ] # std r3,0(r5)            // remember this frame's reading
      - [ be32, 0x00A5763C, 0x7C661850 ] # subf r3,r6,r3           // how many counts went by since last frame
    # turn counts into seconds
      - [ be32, 0x00A57640, 0xF8650010 ] # std r3,16(r5)           // save the count where the FPU can reach it
      - [ be32, 0x00A57644, 0xC8450010 ] # lfd f2,16(r5)           // bring the count in
      - [ be32, 0x00A57648, 0xFC00169C ] # fcfid f0,f2             // make it a real number
      - [ be32, 0x00A5764C, 0xC8250020 ] # lfd f1,32(r5)           // the CPU's speed (80,000,000 counts/sec)
      - [ be32, 0x00A57650, 0xFC000824 ] # fdiv f0,f0,f1           // divide and get the actual seconds
      - [ be32, 0x00A57654, 0xFC000018 ] # frsp f0,f0              // shrink it to single precision
    # tell the game
      - [ be32, 0x00A57658, 0x3CC00145 ] # lis r6,0x0145           
      - [ be32, 0x00A5765C, 0x38C697D8 ] # addi r6,r6,0x97D8       // r6 = game's delta timer
      - [ be32, 0x00A57660, 0xD0060000 ] # stfs f0,0(r6)           // game now knows how fast this frame ran
    # storing f3 for future checks of UI transition (fixes missing menus or text content as "Text" at high framerates)
      - [ be32, 0x00A57664, 0x3D800145 ] # lis r12,0x0145          // r12 = f3's copy
      - [ be32, 0x00A57668, 0xD06C9B30 ] # stfs f3,0x9B30(r12)     // keep f3 out for the accumulator (it's -1.0f while transitioning menus)
      - [ be32, 0x00A5766C, 0x48002E04 ] # b 0x00A5A470            // run the accumulator now

  # accumulator cave - makes the UI advance 60 times per second using real time
    # save up this frame's time
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A470, 0x3D000145 ] # lis r8,0x0145           
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A474, 0x39089B20 ] # addi r8,r8,0x9B20       // r8 = our data
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A478, 0xC0680000 ] # lfs f3,0(r8)            // time saved up from earlier frames
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A47C, 0xEC63002A ] # fadds f3,f3,f0          // add this frame's time
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A480, 0xC0880004 ] # lfs f4,4(r8)            // how long one tick is (1/60 of a second)
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A484, 0xFF832000 ] # fcmpu cr7,f3,f4         // is one full tick saved up?
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A488, 0x419C0010 ] # blt cr7,0x00A5A498      // not yet - hold still
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A48C, 0xEC632028 ] # fsubs f3,f3,f4          // use up one tick
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A490, 0x39200001 ] # li r9,1                 // yes - advance the UI
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A494, 0x4800001C ] # b 0x00A5A4B0            // go tell the gate
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A498, 0x39200000 ] # li r9,0                 // not yet - keep it looking still
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A49C, 0xC0A80010 ] # lfs f5,0x10(r8)         // the f3 dt left for us
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4A0, 0xC0880018 ] # lfs f4,0x18(r8)         // the "rebuilding a menu" marker
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4A4, 0xFC052000 ] # fcmpu cr0,f5,f4         // rebuilding a menu right now?
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4A8, 0x40820008 ] # bne cr0,0x00A5A4B0      // no - stay held
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4AC, 0x39200001 ] # li r9,1                 // yes - go ahead anyway
    # publish the decision
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4B0, 0x3D400145 ] # lis r10,0x0145          
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4B4, 0x394A9B2C ] # addi r10,r10,0x9B2C     // r10 = the "advance?" flag
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4B8, 0x912A0000 ] # stw r9,0(r10)           // publish: move now or hold
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4BC, 0xD0680000 ] # stfs f3,0(r8)           // keep whatever time is left over
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A4C0, 0x4E800020 ] # blr                     // done

  # gate hook
      - [ be32, 0x00418E9C, 0x48641594 ] # jump to gate cave - lwz r9,0x10(r31) -> b 0x00A5A430

  # gate cave - handles UI animation speed by gating it to 60hz
    # only gate the normal UI advance
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A430, 0x7D2802A6 ] # mflr r9                 // who called into here
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A434, 0x3D400042 ] # lis r10,0x0042          
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A438, 0x394A900C ] # addi r10,r10,0x900C     // r10 = the usual caller's address
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A43C, 0x7C095000 ] # cmpw cr0,r9,r10         // is this the usual caller (UI advancer)?
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A440, 0x40820028 ] # bne cr0,0x00A5A468      // anything else - let it through
    # ask the accumulator
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A444, 0x3D400145 ] # lis r10,0x0145          
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A448, 0x394A9B2C ] # addi r10,r10,0x9B2C     // r10 = the "advance?" flag
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A44C, 0x814A0000 ] # lwz r10,0(r10)          // the accumulator's answer for this frame
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A450, 0x2C0A0000 ] # cmpwi cr0,r10,0         // time to advance yet?
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A454, 0x40820014 ] # bne cr0,0x00A5A468      // yes - let it through
    # hold, but let menus build
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A458, 0x813F0010 ] # lwz r9,0x10(r31)        // how long the menu has been up
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A45C, 0x2C090002 ] # cmpwi cr0,r9,2          // still on the first couple frames?
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A460, 0x40810008 ] # ble cr0,0x00A5A468      // yes - let the menu finish building
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A464, 0x4B9BEA7C ] # b 0x00418EE0            // no - skip this move for now
    # resume
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A468, 0x813F0010 ] # lwz r9,0x10(r31)        // run the instruction we hooked at
      - [ be32, 0x00A5A46C, 0x4B9BEA34 ] # b 0x00418EA0            // back to normal

  # Data section
    # dt data
      - [ be32, 0x014497A8, 0x00000000 ] # last clock reading (high)
      - [ be32, 0x014497AC, 0x00000000 ] # last clock reading (low)
      - [ be32, 0x014497B8, 0x00000000 ] # scratch for the count (high)
      - [ be32, 0x014497BC, 0x00000000 ] # scratch for the count (low)
      - [ be32, 0x014497C8, 0x419312D0 ] # CPU speed: 80,000,000.0 (high)
      - [ be32, 0x014497CC, 0x00000000 ] # CPU speed: 80,000,000.0 (low)

    # accumulator / gate data
      - [ be32, 0x01449B20, 0x00000000 ] # saved-up time
      - [ be32, 0x01449B24, 0x3C888889 ] # tick length: 1/60 of a second
      - [ be32, 0x01449B2C, 0x00000000 ] # "should the UI advance?" flag
      - [ be32, 0x01449B30, 0x00000000 ] # f3 stored by the dt cave
      - [ be32, 0x01449B38, 0xBF800000 ] # menu rebuild marker (-1.0f)

  BCES00005_DeltaTimer: &BCES00005_DeltaTimer # Keeps track of time passed using mftb and updates the games internal "ticks passed" accordingly.                                Pseudo-code:    if (time start == 0) {
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x812224C8] # lwz   r9, 0x24c8(r2)    0x10175F28 - memory address we use to store various things, for example a saved timestamp since we started counting.                    SetStartTime:
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xE8890008] # ld    r4, 8(r9)         Load saved start time                                                                                                                       SetTimeStart();
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x2F240000] # cmpdi cr6, r4, 0                                                                                                                                                    *old_timer++;
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x409A0034] # bne   cr6, 0x40         if (start time == 0) {                                                                                                                  } else {
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x7C8C42E6] # mftb  r4, 0x10c         Load current time #10                                                                                                                       const new_timer = CalcNewTick();
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x2F040000] # cmpwi cr6, r4, 0                                                                                                                                                    if (new_timer - *old_timer > 10) {
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x419AFFF8] # beq   cr6, 0x10                                                                                                                                                         goto SetStartTime;
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x3C84FFEC] # addis r4, r4, 0xffec    Subtract 1328000 (timebase_freq / 60)                                                                                                       }
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x3884BC80] # addi  r4, r4, 0xbc80    #20                                                                                                                                         *old_timer = new_timer;
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xF8890008] # std   r4, 8(r9)         Save start time - 1 tick                                                                                                                }
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80A27638] # lwz   r5, 0x7638(r2)
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80850000] # lwz   r4, 0(r5)         Load current tick
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x90890010] # stw   r4, 0x10(r9)      Save start tick #30
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x38840001] # addi  r4, r4, 1
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x90850000] # stw   r4, 0(r5)         Save tick + 1
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x48000068] # b      0xa4             goto end }
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x7C0C42E6] # mftb   r0, 0x10c        Load current time #40
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x2F000000] # cmpwi  cr6, r0, 0
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x419AFFF8] # beq    cr6, 0x40
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x7C040050] # subf   r0, r4, r0       Subtract start time
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xF801FFF0] # std    r0, -0x10(r1)    #50
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xC801FFF0] # lfd    f0, -0x10(r1)
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xFC00069C] # fcfid  f0, f0
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80A24EF0] # lwz    r5, 0x4ef0(r2)
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xC1650000] # lfs    f11, 0(r5)       0x10C78FE4 #60
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xFC0002F2] # fmul   f0, f0, f11      Divide by timebase
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80A2755C] # lwz    r5, 0x755c(r2)
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xC1650000] # lfs    f11, 0(r5)       0x10061BB4
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xFC0002F2] # fmul   f0, f0, f11      Multiply by ticks per second (60.24) #70
    - [be32, 0x0, 0xFC00001E] # fctiwz f0, f0
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x38A1FFF0] # addi   r5, r1, 0xfff0
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x7C002FAE] # stfiwx f0, 0, r5
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x8001FFF0] # lwz    r0, -0x10(r1)    Ticks since start tick #80
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80A90010] # lwz    r5, 0x10(r9)     Start tick
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x7C002A14] # add    r0, r0, r5       New tick
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80A27638] # lwz    r5, 0x7638(r2)
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x80850000] # lwz    r4, 0(r5)        Load current tick #90
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x7C840050] # subf   r4, r4, r0       New tick - current tick
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x2F04000A] # cmpwi  cr6, r4, 0xa
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x4199FF74] # bgt    cr6, 0x10
    - [be32, 0x0, 0x90050000] # stw    r0, 0(r5)        Save new tick #A0

  "Delta time":
    Games:
      "Formula One Championship Edition":
        BCES00005: [ 02.00 ]
    Author: Juhn
    Notes: Adjusts physics according to the fps. If the fps is lower than the original framerate target, the game slows down. By default this original framerate target is 30 fps, enable the 60 fps patch to increase the framerate target to 60 (only do this if you can keep above 60 fps steadily, otherwise there is no point to combine the 60 fps patch with this one). Increase the vblank rate to increase framerate cap accordingly, keeping the vblank rate at 60hz will render this patch useless. This patch does not limit the fps in menus, which can make them hard to navigate. Known issues are replay instability and slight changes to the engine simulation. This patch was developed thanks to a bounty set by Comanso, who also helped with testing.
    Patch Version: 1.0
    Patch:
      - [calloc, 0x503560, 15] # Delta time physics         Hooks into some framerate code and calculates a new physics simulation step size (?).
      - [be32, 0x0, 0x808297DC] # lwz  r4, -0x6824(r2)
      - [be32, 0x0, 0xC0240000] # lfs  f1, 0(r4)            Load default tickrate (60.24 most of the time)
      - [be32, 0x0, 0x8082CF14] # lwz   r4, -0x30ec(r2)

      - [be32, 0x0, 0xFD8C0072] # fmul f12, f12, f1         Multiply by actual frametime i.e. divide by actual framerate. For example when running at 60 fps => 30 * (1 / 60) = 30 / 60 = 0.5

      - [be32, 0x0, 0xFD8C0072] # fmul f12, f12, f1         Multiply the framerate ratio by the default physics step to calculate a new physics step. In our example 0.5 * 0.0055555 = 0,0027778

      - [be32, 0x0, 0x419D000C] # bgt   cr7, 0x43269C       If the new physics step is greater than the default physics step, then leave the current physics step in place. A greater physics step than around 0.006-0.007 results in the physics simulation breaking down.
